# zuutf

Every Unicode encoding R meets, validated and converted at memory speed,
with the exact position of the first error.

zuutf validates text and converts it between UTF-8, UTF-16 (LE and BE),
UTF-32 (LE and BE) and Latin-1, counts characters, detects encodings,
and encodes and decodes Base64. It does this with a bundled copy of
[simdutf](https://github.com/simdutf/simdutf), which picks SIMD code for
the processor at first use. Other packages can call the same functions
from C through a registered table
([`vignette("linking")`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/articles/linking.md)).

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("zuutf")
```

The development version is on GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zuutf")
```

## Validation, with the position of the first error

``` r

library(zuutf)

utf_valid(c("plain", "café", NA))
#> [1]  TRUE  TRUE    NA

bad <- as.raw(c(0x61, 0x62, 0xe2, 0x82, 0x63))   # a truncated euro sign
utf_valid(bad)
#> [1] FALSE
utf_error_at(bad)
#> [1] 3
```

## UTF-16 from Windows tools

``` r

bytes <- readBin("export.csv", "raw", file.size("export.csv"))
utf_detect(bytes)                 # the byte-order mark decides
#> [1] "UTF-16LE"
text <- utf_decode(bytes)         # from = "auto"; the BOM is dropped
```

Ill-formed input raises a classed error by default;
`invalid = "replace"` writes U+FFFD as web browsers do, and
`invalid = "na"` gives `NA`:

``` r

utf_decode(as.raw(c(0x61, 0xff, 0x62)), "UTF-8", invalid = "replace")
#> [1] "a�b"
```

## Base64

``` r

s <- base64_encode(charToRaw("hello, world"))
s
#> [1] "aGVsbG8sIHdvcmxk"
rawToChar(base64_decode(s))
#> [1] "hello, world"
base64_encode(as.raw(0:63), url = TRUE, pad = FALSE)
```

Decoding is forgiving by default, as browsers’ is; `forgiving = FALSE`
reads RFC 4648 strictly.

## Learn more

- [`vignette("zuutf")`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/articles/zuutf.md):
  encodings, error policies and offsets.
- [`vignette("linking")`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/articles/linking.md):
  calling zuutf from another package’s C code.
- [`zuutf_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/zuutf_info.md):
  the simdutf version and the kernel in use.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`base64_encode()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/base64_encode.md)
  [`base64_decode()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/base64_encode.md)
  : Encode and decode Base64
- [`utf_convert()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_convert.md)
  [`utf_decode()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_convert.md)
  [`utf_encode()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_convert.md)
  : Convert between Unicode encodings
- [`utf_count()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_count.md)
  [`utf_length_as()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_count.md)
  : Count code points and conversion lengths
- [`utf_detect()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_detect.md)
  : Detect the encoding of bytes
- [`utf_valid()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_valid.md)
  [`utf_error_at()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_valid.md)
  [`utf_is_ascii()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/utf_valid.md)
  : Validate text in a Unicode encoding
- [`zuutf_error`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/zuutf_error.md)
  : Conditions raised by zuutf
- [`zuutf_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zuutf/reference/zuutf_info.md)
  : Information about the bundled simdutf library
